svg.aria-label: Project 03: Microservices Migration from Docker Compose to Kubernetes on Amazon EKS
svg.title: Project 03: Microservices Migration from Docker Compose to Kubernetes on Amazon EKS
svg.text: Compose to Kubernetes on Amazon EKS
Three Spring Boot microservices and a React/Vite frontend moved from a
Namespace, ConfigMap, Deployment, Service, ALB Ingress and HPA manifests
Cluster via eksctl; Load Balancer Controller with IRSA
NAT Gateway for a stable egress IP
Idempotent bootstrap script that seeds organizations and users
